interruption_rules.WORLD: resume at saved region/anchor/layer; never advance story merely by loading
interruption_rules.DIALOGUE: resume exact source scene cursor or restart current utterance only; no duplicate reward
interruption_rules.UNIQUE_INTERACTION: resume from last safe anchor unless interaction supplies deterministic snapshot
interruption_rules.POKER: restore exact deck order, board, hole cards, street, pending actors, bets, stacks, blind level and event identity
interruption_rules.OBSERVE: preserve resolved NPC event separately from whether full view/summary/bulletin was consumed
interruption_rules.RESULT: result commit is idempotent; loading cannot pay first-time reward twice

migration.v1_to_v2: v1 world saves may load as WORLD only; no fabricated active poker/dialogue session

atomicity: write temporary file then replace canonical save
